style: Photorealistic luxury real estate film. Smooth, slow, steady gimbal camera move. Natural light. Keep the architecture exactly as it is: no people, no added furniture or objects, no text, no warping, no flames or flickering lights.

shots.move: Slow aerial drift forward over the neighborhood toward the distant mountains.
Slow push-in toward the front entry.

Slow dolly forward into the two-story great room, tilting up slightly toward the tall windows. The fire stays small and contained inside the fireplace. Lamps, lights and every object stay exactly where they are.
Slow push forward along the kitchen island.
Slow push toward the dining table and window.
Slow dolly forward into the primary bedroom.
Very slow push-in toward Mount Rainier at alpenglow. The mountain, sky and rooftops stay perfectly still.
Slow push out across the covered deck toward the yard and trees.
Slow push across the lawn toward the back of the house.
